title: Statistical Inference in Causal Partial Identification under Smooth Densities

split.decision: Training-free per-instance estimation. 100 public and 200 hidden instances of (dY,dZ,n)=(2,1,3000), each with its own location model drawn by make_data.py, with secrets-drawn seeds in judge/tools/split_design.json. No outcome-based selection. Original 100 bootstrap resamples retained. Algorithm seeds separated from data seeds.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 2 measures coverage with one fixed distribution per configuration. Here every instance has its own distribution, so there is no published value to compare; public preprint arXiv:2602.20681v1.

allowed_changes: density estimation, conditional optimal-transport solvers, valid confidence-interval construction and numerical optimization
bootstrap resampling or integration from distributions fitted to the current observations; development-selected configuration
fixed_contract: Construct informative 95% confidence intervals for each instance's COT value from its pair of observed groups, minimizing mean interval length subject to coverage.
the instance family with (dY,dZ,n)=(2,1,3000) and one distribution per instance, clipped observed data and independent per-instance boundary
the target, each instance's COT value before clipping
endpoint-inclusive coverage above the task's floors and mean interval length
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: The estimator must stay nonparametric: it may assume smooth densities, but it may not assume a parametric form for the conditional laws, such as a Gaussian or location-scale model, and it may not evaluate the closed-form value of such a model at fitted parameters.
Intervals must target nominal 95% coverage: do not lower the nominal level, scale widths by a factor tuned against validation coverage, or return degenerate intervals on a subset of instances.
changing the estimand to the clipped-data population, replacing the distribution family or relaxing coverage
extra population simulations, lookup of the truth, fitting to truth labels or sharing observations across instances
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
